ruleDefinitions.name: User Added to Remote Desktop Users Group
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects addition of users to the local Remote Desktop Users group via "Net" or "Add-LocalGroupMember".

sequences.query: (((process_command_line = RGX(".*localgroup\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/add.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*Add\\-LocalGroupMember\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-Group\\ .*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Remote\\ Desktop\\ Users.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Utilisateurs\\ du\\ Bureau\\ à\\ distance.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Usuarios\\ de\\ escritorio\\ remoto.*")))
